seoTitle: How to Integrate Courier Guy with Shopify (2026)
metaDescription: Connect The Courier Guy shipping app to your Shopify store to automate waybills, shipping rates, and order tracking for South African fulfillment.
intro: South African Shopify merchants relying on The Courier Guy for fulfillment can automate much of the shipping process by connecting the official app directly to their store. This guide covers installing the app, setting up shipping rates, and generating waybills so orders move through fulfillment with less manual work.

steps.heading: Install the Courier Guy app
steps.body: From the Shopify App Store, install the official Courier Guy shipping integration.

steps.heading: Enter your account credentials
steps.body: Add your Courier Guy account API keys to connect your shipping account to the app.

steps.heading: Set up shipping zones and rates
steps.body: Configure local and national shipping rates for South Africa within the app settings.

steps.heading: Test waybill generation
steps.body: Run a test to confirm automated waybills and manifest labels generate correctly for orders.

steps.heading: Enable tracking notifications
steps.body: Turn on automated tracking updates so customers receive real-time shipping notifications.

steps.heading: Review the checkout experience
steps.body: Do a final checkout review to confirm shipping rates and options display correctly to customers.

faq.question: Do I need an existing Courier Guy account to use this integration?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need your Courier Guy account credentials and API keys to connect the app to your Shopify store.

faq.question: Will waybills generate automatically for new orders?
faq.answer: Yes, once configured, the app is designed to generate automated waybills and manifest labels for your orders.

faq.question: Can customers see real-time shipping rates at checkout?
faq.answer: Yes, the integration is built to provide real-time shipping rates to customers during checkout.

faq.question: Is this integration specific to South African merchants?
faq.answer: Yes, The Courier Guy operates within South Africa, so this integration is aimed at local e-commerce fulfillment.
